defects.description: Buttons are solid black rectangles with no border-radius, text, or hover state styling
defects.location: Bottom of all three pricing cards

defects.description: Pro card has a pale yellow/gold border instead of a professional accent color (e.g., green or blue) to match the original design's palette
The 'Popular' badge on the Pro card appears slightly off-center horizontally relative to the card width
Feature list text in Starter and Team cards is very small and lacks checkmark icons for visual consistency with the Pro card
defects.location: Starter and Team card feature lists

missing_elements: Button labels ('Choose Starter', 'Choose Pro', 'Choose Team') are missing from all three CTA buttons
regressions: Original 'Choose Pro' button had correct green background color and rounded corners; replaced with a black rectangle
Original Pro card had a clean white or subtle shadow appearance; now has a yellow/gold border that feels disconnected from the original green accent system
top_fixes: Add visible text labels to all three CTA buttons (e.g., 'Get Started', 'Choose Pro', 'Contact Sales')
Style buttons with proper border-radius (8-12px), appropriate background colors, and readable text
Change Pro card highlight border to a cohesive accent color (green-500 or similar) that matches the brand feel established in the first iteration
Add checkmark icons to Starter and Team feature lists for consistent visual rhythm across all cards

manifest.prompt: Turn it into a row of three pricing cards side by side: Starter at $0, Pro at $12 with a 'Popular' badge and a highlighted border, and Team at $49.
